result.title: VARI: Robust Text-to-Video Generation via Group-Structured Intent Alignment
result.summary: Modern text-to-video (T2V) models generate visually compelling videos, yet meaning-preserving changes in prompt wording can substantially alter semantic realization and overall quality. Existing prompt rewriting modifies the inference input, whereas conventional post-training constructs supervision from one prompt formulation at a time; neither explicitly optimizes reliability across equivalent forms. We introduce VARI (Verified Alignment over Representations of Intent), a group-structured framework that treats automatically verified formulations of the same visual intent as a shared supervision unit. VARI builds matched form-seed rollout pools, cross-scores each video against all forms, and applies a wording-independent structured intent audit to identify valid realizations and hard semantic failures. Group-Consistent Distillation (GCD) aligns every verified form with interchangeable valid realizations, while Form-Contrastive Flow-DPO (FC-DPO) learns group-level preferences from audited positive-negative pairs, prioritizing same-seed, different-form contrasts. On HunyuanVideo-1.5, VARI attains the highest T2V-CompBench, VBench, and StoryEval scores among the evaluated methods. On prompt-form extensions of T2V-CompBench and VBench, it improves weakest-form alignment over the strongest prompt-level baselines by 2.45 and 3.55 points and reduces cross-form drop by 30.5% and 32.2%, respectively, while preserving visual quality. Human evaluation, natural-caption controls, prompt-enhancement experiments, diversity analyses, and transfer to LTX-2.3 further support the robustness and transferability of these gains, while VARI requires no additional inference-time module.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 VARI 框架，把自动验证的同一视觉意图的多种提示表述视为一个共享监督单元，通过跨形式交叉打分与意图审计，用组一致蒸馏与形式对比 Flow-DPO 提升 text-to-video 生成对改写表述的鲁棒性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「等价形式共享监督单元＋跨形式交叉打分」的组级监督与偏好构造，可能为 LVR 中跨改写输入的监督归因、轨迹训练与贡献分配提供线索，但原文面向视频生成，与推理期状态的关系需核查。
